verdict.rationale: Factory explicitly supports batch/bulk automation via `droid exec` for scripts, CI/CD pipelines, and batch processing, and positions itself to 'put code review, QA, and documentation on autopilot across your repos,' plus Missions for orchestrating large multi-feature work across many components. Missing for 10: a concrete example of bulk operations across many discrete items (e.g., many repos/PRs processed in one command) and independent/hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs.
